title: Lew42 v2: every page now has your Index Root; 1920 Desktop split into columns

owner_note.text: 18 pages now use the Index Root setup: tint fill, 3440 Mega, section-pad, horizontal. Each page's old content sits in one Root Column that keeps its old mode, so nothing inside moved. 1920 Desktop is the split pilot: three titled 1920 Desktop columns (Preview, Masters, Specimens), and the placeholder row went to Archive. Its Root went from 8420×9845, 52% empty, to 9068×4608, 29% empty. The other pages wait for your OK on the pilot; their proposed splits are in root-audit.md.
